title: Python SDK policy group, rule and set controllers
aliases: policy group reorder put post changelog

prose.text: The Python SDK has three policy-group controllers whose routes its own changelog describes differently from the code. The Go comparison is in [[zpa.b2b-federation.sdk-contract]].

prose.label: Routes.
prose.text: {{group-add-reorder-code}} Its changelog says otherwise: {{divergence:python-changelog-routes}} The Go package uses other routes again, and the Go changelog repeats the same add route: [[zpa.b2b-federation.sdk-contract:policy-group-routes]].

checks.do: Whether the code uses the unified ZPAService client, since the legacy client has no policy group properties.
Whether a policy group add or reorder was made against the route in the code, not the one in the changelog.

unified-only.statement: The unified `ZPAService` defines `policy_group`, `policy_group_rule` and `policy_group_set` properties, while the same properties in the legacy ZPA client are commented out.

group-add-reorder-code.statement: `add_group` sends POST to `/policyGroupSet/{group_set_id}/group` and `reorder_group` sends PUT to `/policyGroupSet/{group_set_id}/group/{group_id}/reorder/{new_order}`.

python-search-groups-example-omits-set-i.statement: The Python `search_groups` method requires `group_set_id`, but its embedded example calls it with only `filter_and_sort_dto`, so copying the example raises an argument error before any request.

python-changelog-routes.summary: The Python changelog describes the policy group add and reorder routes with different HTTP methods from the code.

positions.says: The changelog lists GET on `.../group` as the add route and POST on the group reorder route.

quotes: `GET /policyGroupSet/{groupSetId}/group` Add a new Policy Group to a Policy Group Set.
`POST /policyGroupSet/{groupSetId}/group/{groupId}/reorder/{newOrder}` Update an existing Policy Group Order.

python-changelog-routes.impact: A caller following the changelog would use the wrong method for group add and reorder; the specification has no policyGroupSet route to settle it.
